text:
maria: Heads-up — Nightingale Analytics onramp is scheduled Wed 10:00am PT. Need final quota numbers, canary plan, and fallback strategy. tagging eng/sre for capacity checks.
jin: Got it. Can you paste their expected traffic profile (qps/spike pattern)? Also what's their 95th latency SLO?
maria: They expect steady ~120 qps with short spikes up to ~500 qps for 2–3 minutes every hour. Target is <200ms p95 for text-gen. Renewal in ~7 months, so this onboarding is high priority.
alex: Customer note: they use a lot of short-prefix prompts; we should prime cache. Also they asked for a runbook and a 1-hr enablement session.
sam: Proposed run plan: 1) Quota pre-assign: 200k tokens/min (subject to adjust), 2) Canary rollout: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over ~45m with checks, 3) Autoscale policy: scale at 60% GPU util, cooldown 3m, max +2 nodes.
priya: I'll own the load tests in staging. Suggest script: `hey_load --rps 120 --burst 500 --dur 2h --prompts prompts.json --keepalive`. We should also run a hot-prefix pass to warm KV cache.
maria: @priya thanks — can you schedule the staging run tomorrow so we can validate autoscale thresholds? Also need the canary yaml and a short checklist for the enablement call.
leo: I'll coordinate customer comms and set the enablement for Mon 1pm PT. Also want to capture feedback via the onboarding survey immediately after go-live.
jin: Quick questions: 1) Do we pin a specific model/quantization? 2) Fallback behavior if dedicated pool saturates?
alex: Recommendation: pin to r.xlarge-v2-quant for Dedicated. Fallback should be to hosted-compatible variant (r.medium-compat) with throttling and reduced token limits; note that latency will be ~2x.
sam: Fallback policy draft: on saturation fallback to r.medium-compat; reduce max tokens to 512; apply per-customer rate caps and expose a clear 429 path. We'll include this in the runbook.
ops-bot: Notice — scheduled node group maintenance in us-west-2 (node-group-a) at Wed 02:00 UTC. Potential overlap with some prep windows.
jin: Ops note acknowledged. That maintenance could conflict with any late-night priming. Recommend moving priming earlier or confirming maintenance skip for the pool.
priya: I'll shift staging loadtest to Tue 17:00 UTC (which maps to Tue 10:00am PT) to match customer availability for the warmup window. Confirming with infra now.
maria: Please add owners next to each checklist item: Quota assign (maria), Keys/roles (alex), Loadtest (priya), Autoscale tuning (sam), Enablement & comms (leo), Smoke 30m before (jin).
jin: I'll run a 15m smoke 30m prior: basic gen, short prompt latencies, KV cache hitrate. If p95 > 300ms or error rate >0.5% we abort.
alex: Canary config (draft):
```yaml
canary:
  steps:
    - percent: 10
      duration: 15m
      checks: [latency_p95 < 200ms, error_rate < 0.5%]
    - percent: 30
      duration: 15m
      checks: [latency_p95 < 220ms, error_rate < 1%]
    - percent: 100
      duration: 15m
      checks: [latency_p95 < 240ms, error_rate < 1%]
fallback: r.medium-compat
max_tokens: 2048
```
maria: Nice. Add a line to capture immediate post-run feedback: link to onboarding feedback doc (https://redwood.work/onboard-feedback/nightingale).
sam: I'll own autoscale tuning during the run and iterate thresholds if we see oscillations. Priya — please dump GPU util + pod metrics to the run log.
priya: Will do — I'll also save loadtest scripts and prompts to the repo: `infra/loadtests/nightingale/*`.
leo: I'll prepare a short customer-facing summary and send the calendar invite. Also will capture renewal signal while they are enthusiastic — note any friction items for AM.
jin: Quick checklist before go:
- Quota assigned: TODO (maria)
- Keys issued & RBAC checked: TODO (alex)
- KV cache prewarm dataset uploaded: TODO (priya)
- Canary yaml finalized: TODO (alex)
- Enablement scheduled: TODO (leo)
- Autoscale policy deployed: TODO (sam)
- Smoke run scheduled 30m prior: TODO (jin)
maria: Owners set. If staging passes, we have a tentative GO for Wed 10:00am PT. If anything critical, tag #eng-oncall and @jin.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled job created (job-id: rb-canary-171520).
priya: Confirmed staging run scheduled Tue 17:00 UTC. I updated infra ticket (#INF-4892).
alex: I'll drop the final canary yaml and a short `howto` for rollback in the runbook by EOD today.
leo: Thanks team — I'll capture customer feedback immediately after the session and post a short summary here.
maria: Great work. Closing here unless blockers arise. Remember to record the smoke logs and upload to the onboarding folder.
